classification: All retired files are validation CI; no release, deployment or security automation was present.
setup_policy: Use preinstalled user-space Elan (4.2.4 in the campaign environment), each package exact Lean pin and authenticated dependencies. Removed only hosted Elan installation, implicit Actions setup, upload and runner cleanup. Never run archived setup or security-changing installers.

workflows.name: Alexandroff-Urysohn Lean verification
local_commands:
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
test "$(elan run "$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)" lean --version | head -c 4)" = Lean
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
python3 scripts/check_package.py
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
lean --version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean-version.txt"
lake --version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/lake-version.txt"
lake exe cache get Mathlib.Topology.Metrizable.Uniformity Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
set -o pipefail
lake build 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/au-build.log"
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
lake env lean AxiomAudit.lean > "$RUNNER_TEMP/au-axioms.txt"
python3 scripts/check_package.py --axiom-log "$RUNNER_TEMP/au-axioms.txt"
git diff --exit-code

workflows.name: Banach–Mazur Baire Lean verification
local_commands:
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
test "$(elan run "$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)" lean --version | head -c 4)" = Lean
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
python3 scripts/check_package.py
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
lean --version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/banach-mazur-baire-lean-version.txt"
lake --version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/banach-mazur-baire-lake-version.txt"
lake exe cache get Mathlib.Order.Zorn Mathlib.Data.Set.Pairwise.Basic Mathlib.Topology.Baire.Lemmas
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
python3 ../../scripts/check_imported_definitions.py --project-path topology/banach-mazur-baire --dependency-root .lake/packages/mathlib
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
python3 - "$(lean --print-prefix)/src/lean/Init/Prelude.lean" <<'PYCORE'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
manifest = json.loads(pathlib.Path('verification/core-definitions.json').read_text())
source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == manifest['sha256']
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(source)).encode() + b'\0' + source).hexdigest() == manifest['git_blob_sha1']
for excerpt in manifest['excerpts']:
    assert b''.join(source.splitlines(keepends=True)[excerpt['first_line'] - 1:excerpt['last_line']]).decode() == excerpt['text']
PYCORE
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
set -o pipefail
lake build 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/banach-mazur-baire-build.log"
export ELAN_TOOLCHAIN="$(tr -d '\r\n' < lean-toolchain)"
lake env lean AxiomAudit.lean > "$RUNNER_TEMP/banach-mazur-baire-axioms.txt"
python3 scripts/check_package.py --axiom-log "$RUNNER_TEMP/banach-mazur-baire-axioms.txt"
git diff --exit-code

PYCORE
